messages:
Alex Kim: Kicking off bringup for ap-south2 GPU cluster. Priorities: image replication, helm pipelines, and egress limits. Need oncall handoff after smoke.
Priya Shah: Are we still going with signed images + pullthrough cache? That's what prod uses.
Alex Kim: Yes, signed images via registry mirror. We'll seed the mirror with the 'models-prod' tag. Planning: initial seed -> checksum verify -> cache warm -> helm deploy.
Jamal Ortiz: Map of steps? I can run the checksum script and watch registry logs.
Alex Kim: rough commands:
```
# seed images
gsutil cp -r gs://model-artifacts/ap-south2/* /tmp/seed/
registry-cli push --sign /tmp/seed/*
# checksum
registry-cli verify --checksum /tmp/seed/checksums.txt
```
Priya Shah: Note: egress limits on that region are low. We'll need temporary increase for seeding window or use multi-stage fanout.
Rachel Li: tagging for cost tracking: tag cluster with billing:region_onboard and cost_center:infra_boot
Alex Kim: Good call. Also switching some workloads to preemptible GPUs during validation to save cost — but keep permanently reserved for critical services.
Ops Oncall: I'll take the handoff at 2035006800 UTC. What slack thread for smoke failures?
Alex Kim: use #eng-infra and ping @Ops Oncall. Smoke steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-bootstrap
infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: helm-chart-regional-bootstrap v1.2.3 by alex.k
Jamal Ortiz: Seen an image pull 403 during dry-run. Maybe registry token rotation not propagated.
Priya Shah: Check KMS bindings; we had similar with jp1 last quarter.
Alex Kim: Jamal, can you paste the pod logs? 
Jamal Ortiz: `ImagePullBackOff: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = verifying signature: unauthorized`
Priya Shah: Fix: rotate service account token for registry-mirror and restart daemonset `registry-mirror-agent`.
Rachel Li: I'll open a ticket to request temporary egress bump. cc: @Finance for pre-approval.
Ops Oncall: taking over. I'll run the rotate + restart, then re-run checksum. Will report in ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Alex Kim: Thanks. After successful seed we run a small load test: 20 p50 requests for 30s, check tail latency and OOMs.
Ops Oncall: Update: rotated token, restarted agents, re-seeding now. Repro rate down from 403 -> 200 on first pull but healthy.
Jamal Ortiz: checksum verify passed. mirroring logs show 0 failed pulls.
Alex Kim: handing to @Priya Shah for validation and to @Rachel Li for billing handoff. Next steps in runbook: final keystore rotation and add cluster to autoscaling policy.
Priya Shah: will validate and run canary for 6 hours. ping me if anything else.
Rachel Li: billing tags applied. filing invoice estimate for the reserved capacity window.
Ops Oncall: closing handoff, leaving monitoring alert for next 48h. :white_check_mark:
